cleavage agent: Trypsin digestion was performed to generate peptides
enrichment method: we conducted RNA pull-down assays using biotinylated tRF-24 or its antisense control, followed by mass spectrometry (MS) analysis.
instrument: analyzed by mass spectrometry using a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
labeling: Proteins captured by the tRF-24 RNA pulldown assay were quantified and denatured through reduction and alkylation.
